All 25 backend pytest tests pass (added TestVendorEndpoints regression class covering /vendor/products, /vendor/orders, and RBAC for customer). seed() re-hashes admin password on every startup (idempotent but wasteful).

All 4 role dashboards route to /dashboard (not /vendor, /customer etc.) — the component renders role-specific content based on user role, not URL path. rca of the issue: Fixed already by main agent in /app/backend/server.py vendor_orders(): the previous implementation used `await` inside an `any(...)` generator expression which produced an async_generator instead of a boolean. New code first materializes vendor product IDs via to_list, then iterates orders in pure Python. Verified: GET /api/vendor/orders returns 200 with vendor token; Vendor dashboard loads with no 500 in Network tab and no runtime overlay.
